description: Look up one insider's identity by CIK (SEC's numeric filer identifier, e.g. 0001214128) — returns name, all known titles, and director/officer/10%-owner role flags. If you only have a name, resolve it to a CIK first with the generated search_insiders tool. For trading history use get_insider_transactions or get_insider_career_summary instead. Free plan.

cik.description: Insider CIK number — SEC's numeric filer identifier, e.g. 0001214128. Leading zeros optional. Resolve a name to a CIK first with search_insiders if you don't already have it.

name: get_insider_profile
